title: Cancellation Refund Amount — Northgate Memberships
content:
## 1. Refundable current-year fees

The refundable current-year fees of a Northgate Memberships membership are the new membership, renewal and upgrade difference fees charged for the current membership year less every refund already booked against them, plus, where the tier's refund includes add-on fees, the add-on card fees charged for the current membership year less every refund already booked against them, taken to the cent.

## 2. Unused months

The unused months are the whole months from the cancellation date to the expiry date. A month counts only when the expiry date's day of the month has reached the cancellation date's day of the month.

## 3. Cancellation refund share

The cancellation refund share is the whole of the refundable current-year fees when the cancellation comes no more than the tier's full refund window of days after the first day of the current membership year, and after that window the unused months divided by twelve where the tier prorates after the window and nothing where it does not. Days are calendar days counted from the first day of the current membership year, that day being day 0.

## 4. Annual Reward earned in the current year

The reward accrued for the current membership year less the reward reversed for it, taken to the cent. It is deducted only where the tier's refund deducts it.

## 5. The refund

The cancellation refund is the refundable current-year fees multiplied by the cancellation refund share and rounded to the cent, less the Annual Reward earned in the current year where the tier's refund deducts it, never below zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical memberships; year 1 January to 31 December 2027)

| Membership and ledger | Cancellation date | Day | Share | Working | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Club; renewal 65.00 | 20 February 2027 | 50, inside a 90-day window | whole | 65.00 | 65.00 |
| Club; renewal 65.00 | 10 August 2027 | 221, after the window; tier prorates; 4 unused months | 4 twelfths | 65.00 multiplied by 4, divided by twelve | 21.67 |
| Club Plus; renewal 130.00; Annual Reward earned 18.40 | 15 March 2027 | 73, inside a 90-day window | whole | 130.00 less 18.40 | 111.60 |
| Business Plus; renewal 130.00; two add-on fees of 65.00, one already refunded in full | 10 August 2027 | after a 60-day window; 4 unused months | 4 twelfths | 195.00 multiplied by 4, divided by twelve is 65.00; less Annual Reward earned 12.00 | 53.00 |
| Student Club; renewal fee for the year | 15 February 2027 | 45, after a 30-day window; tier does not prorate | nothing | — | nothing |
